commit.message:
[Feature][MRV2] Default VL encoder disaggregation to Model Runner V2 (#19183)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Unset `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER` now keeps VL encoder disaggregation on
Model Runner V2. This removes both halves of that blacklist entry:

- `ec_transfer_config` is configured (`VL encoder disaggregation`)
- `mm_encoder_only` is set and `ec_transfer_config` is not (`VL
encoder-only`)

`VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0` still forces V1, and `=1` still forces V2.
VL encoder graph (`compilation_config.cudagraph_mm_encoder`) stays on
the V1 blacklist.

Mooncake and CPU-offload EC tests already pin
`VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`. The unset-env cases this changes are
`tests/e2e/pull_request/two_card/test_disaggregated_encoder.py`
(`Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct`, `ECExampleConnector`) and the weekly
`qwen2-5-vl-7b-epd` case.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. With `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER` unset, a request that sets
`ec_transfer_config` or `mm_encoder_only` now uses Model Runner V2. Set
`VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0` to keep V1.

### How was this patch tested?

- Unit tests updated: `tests/ut/test_mrv2_utils.py`.
`ec_transfer_config` and `mm_encoder_only` moved from the V1 blacklist
cases to the default-V2 cases. Explicit env override still wins.
- NPU e2e was not run here. CI should run `test_disaggregated_encoder`.

---

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: I reviewed whether this change
involves boundary conditions. The unit test covers both
`ec_transfer_config` and `mm_encoder_only`, plus the explicit env
override.
- [ ] **Regression test**: If this PR fixes a bug, I added a regression
test that would fail without the fix.
- [ ] **Error / failure path coverage**: I covered abnormal paths in
addition to the happy path.
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: The updated tests assert runner
selection, not just that the suite runs.
- [ ] **Performance impact**: This PR does not touch a
performance-sensitive path.

- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/544f182d9f0c9bfe8bd7645525951d5e3692a542

---------

Signed-off-by: yjyang62 <yangjinyang5@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: yangjinyang <yangjinyang5@huawei.com>
